corpus.title: Synthetic contract evidence challenge
corpus.description: Three compact AI-authored contract-like texts with fifteen source-anchored questions covering single evidence, multi-evidence, exceptions, cross-document distractors, and unanswerable cases. This corpus is not legal advice, law-validated, held out, or customer proof.

evidence.text: Buyer must pay each undisputed invoice within twenty calendar days after receipt.
Seller must dispatch components by the shipment date in the order form.
Buyer must report delayed delivery in writing within five business days after the shipment date.
A routine shipment notice does not constitute a delayed-delivery report.
Seller will replace components that fail inspection before acceptance.
A service credit is available only if Buyer submitted the delayed-delivery report required by clause 2.2 of the Supply Agreement.
The credit request must identify the affected order and arrive within ten business days after delivery.
A general complaint is not a credit request.
Standard support operates from 09:00 to 17:00 on business days.
A critical incident means a complete interruption of the hosted service.
Routine maintenance announced two days in advance is not a critical incident.
Support requests must identify the account and describe the observed interruption.

queries.text: When must Buyer pay an undisputed invoice?

answer_spans.text: Buyer must pay each undisputed invoice within twenty calendar days after receipt.

queries.text: By what date must Seller dispatch the components?

answer_spans.text: Seller must dispatch components by the shipment date in the order form.

queries.text: How and when must Buyer report delayed delivery?

answer_spans.text: Buyer must report delayed delivery in writing within five business days after the shipment date.

queries.text: Does a routine shipment notice count as the delayed-delivery report?

answer_spans.text: A routine shipment notice does not constitute a delayed-delivery report.

queries.text: What happens to components that fail inspection before acceptance?

answer_spans.text: Seller will replace components that fail inspection before acceptance.

queries.text: What delayed-delivery report and credit-request steps are both required for a service credit?

answer_spans.text: Buyer must report delayed delivery in writing within five business days after the shipment date.
A service credit is available only if Buyer submitted the delayed-delivery report required by clause 2.2 of the Supply Agreement.
The credit request must identify the affected order and arrive within ten business days after delivery.

queries.text: What must a credit request identify and when must it arrive?

answer_spans.text: The credit request must identify the affected order and arrive within ten business days after delivery.

queries.text: Is a general complaint treated as a credit request?

answer_spans.text: A general complaint is not a credit request.

queries.text: During which hours does standard support operate?

answer_spans.text: Standard support operates from 09:00 to 17:00 on business days.

queries.text: What is a critical incident, and which announced maintenance is excluded?

answer_spans.text: A critical incident means a complete interruption of the hosted service.
Routine maintenance announced two days in advance is not a critical incident.

queries.text: What information must a support request contain?

answer_spans.text: Support requests must identify the account and describe the observed interruption.

queries.text: Compare the affected-order requirement for a credit request with the account and interruption details for a support request.

answer_spans.text: The credit request must identify the affected order and arrive within ten business days after delivery.
Support requests must identify the account and describe the observed interruption.
